projection.purpose: Define portable data boundaries before host layouts.

contract.input: Commands, player data, inspection data, content and save formats.
contract.step: Give each contract a version and explicit compatibility rule.
Reject unknown IDs and incompatible shapes.
contract.invariant: Machine-readable structure does not establish literary correctness.

test.given: A host sends an unknown command field.
test.then: Accept only the declared version policy or refuse without mutation.
